richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kalyan Dombivli

c: Kalyan and Dombivli are about 28 km from our factory in Vasai, which makes the twin cities one of the shortest road trips we make. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to housing societies, schools, colleges and gardens under the Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation. The machines go from the factory to your site by road, and our installation team fixes them as per the approved layout.

Kalyan-Dombivli societies are often tall buildings with a small open area, so space planning comes first. The Mumbai region also gets very heavy rain from June to September, which means good drainage under the gym matters. Our frames are galvanised and the seats roto-moulded for that weather. Call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266, or share your site size and photos for a layout drawing.

items.q: How do we get a quote for a society in Kalyan-Dombivli?
items.a: Call sales on +91 902 830 2266, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM, or email sales@funplaysystems.com. Share the open area size and photos, and we will send a layout and quote.

items.q: Which outdoor gym suits a small society garden?
items.a: A multi gym frame puts several exercises in one compact footprint. Add one or two single machines if space allows, with the clear area for each kept free.

items.q: How do we protect the machines in the monsoon?
items.a: The galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats are made for outdoor use. Make sure water drains away from the bases, and check moving parts after the rains.
